cells.quote: Students enrolled in private medical colleges were more likely to report good readiness for SDL (58.4%) compared to those enrolled in public sector medical colleges (41.6%).
cells.note: Observational cross-sectional comparison; no random assignment.

cells.quote: There was no significant difference between male and female or hosteller and day scholar students regarding their readiness for self-directed learning.
cells.note: No equivalence test or adequate-power claim is reported, so the nonsignificant result is coded ns rather than 0.
